create_magnitude_aware_guidance: create a MagnitudeAwareGuidance instance with configurable guidance_scale, alpha, and guidance_rescale parameters
run_mambo_guidance: run mambo_guidance to apply magnitude-aware mitigation for boosted classifier-free guidance on noise predictions
test_magnitude_aware_guidance_forward: test the forward method of MagnitudeAwareGuidance to compute guided noise predictions with optional rescaling
review_magnitude_aware_guidance_prepare_: review the prepare_inputs method of MagnitudeAwareGuidance to batch and prepare conditional and unconditional prediction inputs
summarize_magnitude_aware_guidance_is_ma: summarize the _is_mambo_g_enabled method that determines whether magnitude-aware guidance is active based on step range and guidance scale
